title: The Two Schools at the Stream

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A Nature villager and a Science villager argue about the dwindling stream: study it, or protect it at once.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The stream behind the village has been getting smaller. (subject), who leans toward the Nature school, says the village must stop taking water from the upper pools now, before it is too late. (friend), of the Science school, says first they should measure and find out what is really happening. Both are worried. What should the village do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) spends a moon measuring: marking the water level on stones, counting the pools, watching where it goes. The answer is a fallen tree upstream, diverting half the water. The tree is moved. (subject) admits measuring was useful. (friend) admits (friend.he/she) would never have walked that far upstream otherwise.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village stops taking water from the upper pools at once. It is inconvenient for everyone. The stream does not get smaller. It does not get bigger either. Nobody knows why. (friend) is still itching to measure it.
